|game_text=Deploy on table. Your non-unique aliens are immune to [[Grimtaash]] (while you have < 13 cards in hand), [[The Camp (V){{!}}The Camp]], and deployment costs on [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough{{!}}Watch Your Step]]. During battle with two non-unique aliens of your Rep's species, your aliens there may not have their forfeit reduced. [Immune to Alter]
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Well Guarded (V) (Virtual Block 8)]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image here is the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-wellguarded-pre.gif]]). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; differences that come only from a document's medium (icons written out in words on the card list, straight quotes, credit lines) are not changes.
* '''Original''' ([[Well Guarded (V) (Virtual Block 8)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"), page 3, slip 15 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table. Your non-unique aliens are immune to Grimtaash (while you have < 13 cards in hand), The Camp, and deployment costs on Watch Your Step. During battle with two non-unique aliens of your Rep's species, your aliens there may not have their forfeit reduced. [Immune to Alter]” The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Well Guarded (V) (Virtual Block 8) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “Your non-unique aliens” to “Non-unique aliens” and “deployment costs” to “deployment conditions” (and printed “(While you have < 13 cards in hand) ,” as published)<ref name="cl-1281_15-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013 and on the Virtual Master list (VMasterType)</ref>: “Deploy on table. Non-unique aliens are immune to Grimtaash (While you have < 13 cards in hand) , The Camp, and deployment conditions on Watch Your Step. During battle with two non-unique aliens of your Rep's species, your aliens there may not have their forfeit reduced. (Immune to Alter.)” The card list is a text page: no slip, picture or slip number, and icons are written out in words.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Well Guarded (V) (Virtual Block 8) (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 33)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=33, page 33. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=33 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Deploy on table. Your non-unique aliens are immune to Grimtaash (while you have < 13 cards in hand), The Camp, and deployment costs on Watch Your Step. During battle with two non-unique aliens of your Rep's species, your aliens there may not have their forfeit reduced. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' “Your non-unique aliens”, “(while you have < 13 cards in hand),” and “deployment costs” again, for the card list's “Non-unique aliens”, “(While you have < 13 cards in hand) ,” and “deployment conditions”. The Master List repeats words published earlier; it is a version of its own because it was published after a different text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC website card list was generated from the Holotable card data; the Master List went back to the release-sheet words. The Master List slip is the lower part of the card, as on the release sheet; like the slip, it prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-wellguarded-pre.gif]]) prints: “Deploy on table. Your non-unique aliens are immune to Grimtaash (while you have < 13 cards in hand), The Camp, and deployment costs on Watch Your Step. During battle with two non-unique aliens of your Rep's species, your aliens there may not have their forfeit reduced. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' Nothing in the words: the card image prints the Master List words exactly. The image is undated. The PC's image folder (Virtual8-Dark) lists the file, with every other file in it, as last modified on 7 May 2013<ref name="r6-Virtual8-Dark">[https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034744/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Apache directory listing of Virtual8-Dark/large] (Internet Archive, captured 18 August 2019): every file in the folder last modified 7 May 2013; the captures of the image in 2018 and 2019 have the same bytes as the file on the wiki. Research note R6, 11 November 2026.</ref>; it is dated by that upload date, after the Master List (27 April 2013), so it is the latest publication and the current text. The date is a bulk upload of the whole folder, so the image may have been made earlier, but the wiki orders versions by the date each document was published (Bill, 11 November 2026). It is a version of its own even though its words repeat an earlier text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version). The card image is the whole card, with the Decipher picture; like the slip, it prints no slip number. GEMP's current card plays these words: only your non-unique aliens are immune (play change from the card-list text, approved by Bill, 11 November 2026).
